name: InFocus Group Holdings Limited
summary: Based in Northbridge, Australia, InFocus Group Holdings Limited (formerly Frugl Group Limited until November 2024) was established in 2001 as a data intelligence and software solutions provider. The company's operations encompass several key areas: Prodigy 9 offers technology consulting services specializing in data analytics, Fintech, and ERP solutions; Frugl Grocery provides a mobile application enabling consumers to compare prices and manage wellness; and Onify tech delivers end-to-end digital services, including business intelligence and software development. Additionally, InFocus Group operates InFocus Analytics, a retail intelligence platform that aggregates pricing and shopper data for commercial use by retailers, suppliers, and related businesses. Its service portfolio is further strengthened by offerings in bespoke software development, team augmentation, external support, and advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities.
